chunks: The venerable Sheikh, the jurist Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Isam al-Kulayni narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni from Ali ibn Muhammad known as Allan from Muhammad ibn al-Faraj al-Rakhji. He said:

I wrote to Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Musa ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them) asking him about what Hisham ibn al-Hakam said regarding the body [of Allah] and what Hisham ibn Salim said regarding the form. So he (peace be upon him) wrote: Leave the perplexity of the perplexed and seek refuge in Allah from Satan. The [correct] doctrine is not what the two Hishams said.

key_terms.الْهِشَامَانِ: The two Hishams: Hisham ibn al-Hakam and Hisham ibn Salim, whose anthropomorphist doctrines were rejected by the Imam

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali al-Hadi say about the doctrines of the two Hishams on God's body and form?
ai.summary: The 10th Imam Ali al-Hadi (AS) was asked by letter about the doctrines of Hisham ibn al-Hakam (that God has a body) and Hisham ibn Salim (that God has a form). The Imam dismisses both views, instructing the questioner to abandon such confusion and seek refuge in Allah from Satan, declaring that the correct doctrine is not what the two Hishams taught.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Muhammad b. `Asim al-Kulayni narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ya`qub al-Kulayni from `Ali b. Muhammad also known as `Alan from Muhammad al-Faraj al-Rakhji. He said:

I wrote to Abi’l Hasan `Ali b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. Musa b. Ja`far b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) asking him about what Hisham b. al-Hakam said regarding the body [of Allah] and what Hisham b. Salim said regarding the form. So, he (as) wrote: Leave the perplexity of the perplexed and seek refuge in Allah from Satan. The [correct] doctrine is not what the two Hishams have said.
